done_when: Forge records hold, owner decision, wait and resume times with timestamps, keeps the first start of an item through rewrites and fix-to-task moves, and the How it went record splits start-to-merge into these parts; new and existing repos get it on upgrade
why: Start-to-merge records are unreliable: starts can be rewritten (a task's early commits rewritten to one later time, a fix that became a task keeping the child's start), repairs show zero minutes, and unexplained time is labelled 'nothing running'
